fields.description: The vendor's Provider Name, as every record of it carries it. Not a link: the list belongs to the vendor, and one gateway in every geography reads it.
fields.label: Provider Name

fields.description: A `tools[].type` value (web_search_20250305), or a top-level request field (web_search_options), that asks the vendor to run a tool it bills outside the token counts. Only a priced tool belongs here: one priced in tokens alone goes through. A request that names it is a 400 at the gateway, before the vendor is dialled.
fields.label: Tool
